strategyPosture: Watch. The tape is a correction with the AI complex below its buy zones, credit calm but VIX still above 25 — no tranche is armed, so hold bills and let the bottom prove itself; the only work now is screening the DATA_AHEAD names for the re-entry list.

themes.counterRead: The divergence is real and worth tracking, since credit conditions can flip, but with lending loose and the index holding well above a 20% drawdown, the weight is on leadership rotation out of the AI winners, not a confirmed broad rollover. The risk is mistaking a concentrated unwind for a market-wide one and selling the index at the wrong level.

themes.counterRead: Narrative and data agree: this is a leverage unwind, and the portfolio's levered sleeve is where the damage is. Nothing here argues for averaging down — the leveraged names fall faster than the index on the way down. The right read is damage control, not opportunity, until the episode tally confirms a bottom.
